cover.explanation: The PR claims a fix and the claim holds: the base-branch docs describe the Tauri desktop app as providing 'a native desktop experience for managing models and chatting with LLMs running on lemond', but the base-branch user-agent check sent every Android-looking UA — including the Linux desktop app's WebKitGTK UA — to the Play store. Making the desktop shell skip the store redirect while leaving mobile browser redirects unchanged delivers the documented behavior, and issue #3577 is only evidence that the behavior had broken.

surfaces.by: docs/dev/app.md (Overview) on the base branch: 'This app provides a native desktop experience for managing models and chatting with LLMs running on `lemond`.' The base-branch renderer entry (src/app/src/renderer/index.tsx) unconditionally redirected any /android/i user agent to the Google Play store, and the desktop app's WebKitGTK webview UA carries an Android compatibility token, so the documented desktop experience failed on Linux; skipping the redirect inside Tauri while leaving mobile browser redirects unchanged delivers the documented behavior. Linked issue #3577 is evidence of the deviation, not the source of intent.

explanation.body: The title, body, and template claims describe what the diff does.
explanation.diff: The diff moves the inline mobile-user-agent redirect out of src/app/src/renderer/index.tsx into a new getMobileStoreUrl utility in src/app/src/renderer/utils/mobileStoreRedirect.ts, which returns null when running inside Tauri so the desktop shell (whose WebKitGTK UA contains a 'like Android 4.4' token) no longer bounces to the Play store; isTauri is exported from tauriShim.ts and a regression test is added in test/app/app-regression/mobileStoreRedirect.test.cjs. The body's claim of 'a special case for Tauri to avoid redirects' matches the diff exactly, and the 'no breaking changes' box is correct.
explanation.quality: I checked the base docs tree (guide/, dev/, integrations/) for a page owning the mobile store redirect behavior; none exists and the fix adds no flag, endpoint, config key, or backend, so no doc edit is owed. The new regression test test/app/app-regression/mobileStoreRedirect.test.cjs is auto-discovered by test/app/run-app-regression-tests.cjs and runs in the docs_and_style.yml app-regression-tests job on every pull_request, with npm ci providing the typescript it compiles against. Its Tauri-desktop case asserts the post-fix null result for the WebKitGTK Android-token user agent, so it fails if the redirect regression returns.
